verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

xrefs.text: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice — not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

And you, My servant Jacob, do not be afraid, declares the LORD, for I am with you. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have banished you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.”
Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.

verses.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.

xrefs.text: Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.
See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.

verses.text: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?

xrefs.text: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.
Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.text: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.

xrefs.text: Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.
Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,
Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
Yet from the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Hosts. “But you ask, ‘How can we return?’

verses.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?

xrefs.text: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.
“What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.

verses.text: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

xrefs.text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
So I am allotted months of futility, and nights of misery are appointed to me.
The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief, and your eyes no rest.

verses.text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.

xrefs.text: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
My eyes have grown dim with grief, and my whole body is but a shadow.
Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of these, our eyes grow dim—
Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.

verses.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

xrefs.text: And he will answer, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all you evildoers.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!
To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah

verses.text: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

xrefs.text: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.

verses.text: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

xrefs.text: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior. Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. Since they have not succeeded, they will be utterly put to shame, with an everlasting disgrace that will never be forgotten.
So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.
Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
